structure_notes: The source is hands-only throughout; no face or talking-head presenter appears.
The hook uses a family-sharing reversal, followed by quantity, package, product-detail, break-open and milk-use proof.
The adaptation keeps the family-sharing function and milk use case but drops price, pack count, ingredient, aroma and taste claims.
The camera stays close to the tabletop product, alternating first-person high angles, direct overhead inserts and macro hand demonstrations.
No source-derived frame may be used as an ImageGen or H3 reference.

beats.visual_action: Hands lift several biscuits from a full basket and fan them toward the lens.
beats.visual_sync: The family-sharing reversal lands as both hands present more biscuits.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 本来是给儿子买的这个蔬菜小饼干,结果收到货我们全家都抢着吃。

beats.visual_action: A shipping box opens, then one retail pack is lifted close to camera.
beats.visual_sync: The quantity statement lands on the overhead box view.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 个位数到手,满满一大箱12包。

beats.visual_action: The package opens and biscuits move into the creator's hands and basket.
beats.visual_sync: The words about opening land exactly on the tear-open action.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 一打开就闻到了浓浓的奶香和蔬菜的清香。

beats.visual_action: The front package fills the frame while a fingertip points at its printed claim area.
beats.visual_sync: The ingredient number lands on the package-front point.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 它是由10种蔬菜精心搭配而成,

beats.visual_action: Hands show biscuit edges in two stacks, then turn several fronts toward the lens.
beats.visual_sync: The shape and surface statement lands on the closest biscuit.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 圆圆的小饼干上裹满了蔬菜粒,

beats.visual_action: A full basket is shown, then two hands break one biscuit and reveal the interior.
beats.visual_sync: The sensory phrase lands as the biscuit separates into two halves.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 吃起来咸香酥脆的。饿的时候来一包真的太过瘾了,

beats.visual_action: Biscuits are placed in milk and lifted with a spoon for the final result.
beats.visual_sync: The milk use case lands on the cut to the bowl.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 拿来泡牛奶吃也很不错。
